**Current British Royal Family – members (those who carry a royal title or who are the direct children‑in‑line of the monarch) and the name of each person’s father**

| Royal family member (as of 2025) | Title / Relationship | Father |
|----------------------------------|----------------------|--------|

| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | Younger son of the King | **King Charles III** |
| **Meghan, Duchess of Sussex** | Wife of the Duke of Sussex | **Thomas Markle** |
| **Archie Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Son of Harry & Meghan | **Prince Harry** |
| **Lilibet “Lili” Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Daughter of Harry & Meghan | **Prince Harry** |
| **Princess Anne, The Princess Royal** | Daughter of Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Sir Timothy Laurence** | Husband of Princess Anne | **Sir Walter Laurence** |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | Son of Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs E. van Cutsem** | Daughter of Prince Andrew | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs J. Jay** | Daughter of Prince Andrew | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex** | Son of Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Sophie, Countess of Wessex** | Wife of Prince Edward | **Christopher Rhys‑Jones** |
| **Lady Louise Windsor** | Daughter of Prince Edward & Sophie | **Prince Edward** |
| **James, Viscount Severn** | Son of Prince Edward & Sophie | **Prince Edward** |
| **Peter Phillips** | Son of Princess Anne (first child of the Queen) | **Mark Phillips** |
| **Savannah Phillips** | Grand‑daughter of Princess Anne, daughter of Peter | **Peter Phillips** |
| **Isla Phillips** | Grand‑daughter of Princess Anne, daughter of Peter | **Peter Phillips** |
| **Zara Tindall (née Phillips)** | Grand‑daughter of Princess Anne, daughter of Peter | **Mark Phillips** |
| **Mike Tindall** | Husband of Zara | **Michael Tindall** |
| **Mia Tindall** | Great‑grand‑daughter of the Queen, daughter of Zara & Mike | **Mike Tindall** |

### How the list was compiled
* The “current” family is taken to mean those who **hold a royal style or are direct descendants of the reigning monarch (King Charles III) and are regularly listed on the official website of the British Royal Family**.  
* For each person we give the **biological father’s name** (or, for spouses, the father of the spouse).  
* The table includes the monarch, his consort, their children and grandchildren, the Queen’s other children, their spouses, and the grandchildren of the Queen who carry royal titles or are widely recognised as members of the “royal family”.

> **Note:** Many extended relatives (cousins, great‑cousins, etc.) are also descendants of Queen Elizabeth II and Prince Philip, but they do not hold a royal style and are generally not listed as “members of the British Royal Family” in official communications. They have been omitted for brevity.
